title: Flat Troll Blue Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf, 8.75-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Toilet Paper Holder, Allied Brass
description: Toilet paper holder with glass shelf for bathroom use, sized 8.75 inches L x 4.6 inches H x 6 inches W (8.75-inch, 8.75in) — available in Flat Troll Blue, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary bathroom designs. Wall mount / wall-mounted two-post toilet tissue holder with a glass shelf above the roll to keep small items dry and within reach. Solid brass construction (brass hardware) with concealed screw mounting for a clean look. Use as a toilet paper holder, toilet tissue holder, bathroom tissue holder, toilet roll holder, or wall mount toilet paper holder with shelf. Includes toilet paper holder and all installation hardware; assembly required: false. Weight capacity: 250 lb. Limited lifetime warranty. Coordinates with transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware in the Waverly Place collection (matching Waverly Place, grooved bathroom hardware) by Allied Brass.
